extra_vocab.en: the act of making something continue for a new period of time
extra_vocab.note: 合約、會員資格、執照快到期時最常用的字。像這篇對話在討論維護合約要不要續約，renewal 就是「續約」這個動作，常和 fee、date、terms 一起出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: renewal 是名詞，後面用 of 接續約的對象（the renewal of the contract）；動詞是 renew，直接接受詞（renew the contract）。

example.en: Automatic renewals can lead to unexpected charges on your card.
example.zh: 自動續約可能讓你的信用卡出現意料之外的扣款。

example.en: The contract renewal must be approved by the finance manager.
example.zh: 合約續約必須經過財務經理核准。

example.en: The renewal fee is due thirty days before the license expires.
example.zh: 續約費用須在執照到期前三十天繳交。

example.en: Please mark the renewal date on the shared team calendar.
example.zh: 請把續約日期標在團隊共用的行事曆上。

example.en: Cancel before the automatic renewal if you do not need the service.
example.zh: 如果你不需要這項服務，請在自動續約前取消。

examples.en: We are discussing the renewal of our maintenance contract this week.
examples.zh: 我們本週正在討論維護合約的續約。

examples.en: Thank you for your renewal; your membership now runs until next December.
examples.zh: 感謝您續約，您的會員資格現在可使用到明年十二月。

examples.en: A three-year renewal would give us a lower monthly rate.
examples.zh: 續約三年可以讓我們拿到較低的月費。

similar.diff: extension 是把現有期限往後延，不一定重新簽約；renewal 是讓合約或資格重新生效一段新的期間。

example.en: The client asked for a two-week extension on the payment deadline.
example.zh: 客戶要求付款期限延長兩週。

confusable.diff: renewable 是形容詞，「可以續約的、可再生的」；renewal 是名詞，「續約這件事」。
confusable.usage: renewable 是形容詞，放在名詞前或 be 動詞後；renewal 是名詞，前面常加 the 或 a。

example.en: The service agreement is renewable each year for a small fee.
example.zh: 這份服務協議每年可以付一小筆費用續約。

confusable.diff: removal 是「移除、搬走」，字形和發音都很像 renewal，但意思完全不同。

example.en: The removal of old equipment is included in the renewal price.
example.zh: 舊設備的移除包含在續約價格內。

example.en: The expiration of the warranty is listed on the first page.
example.zh: 保固到期日印在第一頁。

example.en: The contract term is twelve months, starting from January.
example.zh: 合約期間為十二個月，從一月開始。

derived.link: re-（再）+ new（新），再弄新一次，像 rebuild、redo

extra_vocab.en: to feel pain or have a bad experience
extra_vocab.note: 在「處罰」的解釋裡，suffer 指讓人承受不好的後果。商務情境中常見的是 suffer a loss（遭受損失）、suffer from（受…之苦）。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: suffer 後面直接接名詞表示「遭受」（suffer a loss）；表示「受…之苦、患有」要用 suffer from + 名詞。

example.en: The whole team suffers when one department misses its deadline.
example.zh: 只要有一個部門趕不上期限，整個團隊都會受影響。

example.en: The company suffered heavy losses after the supplier delayed shipments.
example.zh: 供應商延遲出貨後，公司蒙受了嚴重損失。

example.en: Several branches are suffering from a shortage of trained staff.
example.zh: 有幾間分店正苦於缺少受過訓練的員工。

example.en: The retailer may suffer a loss if the order is canceled.
example.zh: 如果訂單被取消，零售商可能會蒙受損失。

example.en: Many small firms suffer from late payments by large clients.
example.zh: 許多小公司苦於大客戶延遲付款。

example.en: The goods could suffer damage if they are stored near water.
example.zh: 如果貨物放在靠近水的地方，可能會受損。

example.en: Companies that ignore safety rules must suffer the consequences.
example.zh: 無視安全規定的公司必須承擔後果。

examples.en: We do not want our customers to suffer because of our mistake.
examples.zh: 我們不希望客戶因為我們的錯誤而受苦。

examples.en: Any company that breaks the rule will suffer a penalty.
examples.zh: 任何違反規定的公司都會受到處罰。

examples.en: Sales may suffer if we raise prices during the busy season.
examples.zh: 如果我們在旺季調漲價格，銷售可能會受影響。

similar.diff: endure 強調忍受並撐過困難的過程；suffer 強調承受不好的事所帶來的傷害或損失。

example.en: Staff had to endure long delays during the system upgrade.
example.zh: 系統升級期間，員工必須忍受長時間的延誤。

similar.diff: go through 較口語，只是「經歷」，不一定有受傷害的意思。

example.en: The company had to go through a difficult year of budget cuts.
example.zh: 公司經歷了預算大幅削減的艱困一年。

confusable.diff: suffice 是「足夠」，字形開頭與 suffer 相同；suffer 是「遭受」，意思完全不同。

example.en: A short email will suffice, so nobody has to suffer a long meeting.
example.zh: 一封簡短的電子郵件就夠了，這樣沒有人要熬過冗長的會議。

example.en: The company reported a loss of two million dollars last year.
example.zh: 公司去年回報了兩百萬美元的虧損。

example.en: Late delivery may harm our relationship with the retailer.
example.zh: 延遲交貨可能會損害我們與零售商的關係。

senses.en: to have something bad happen to you
senses.distinguish: 後面直接接 loss、damage、delay 等名詞。

example.en: The store suffered a sharp drop in sales last winter.
example.zh: 這家店去年冬天銷售額大幅下滑。

senses.en: to feel pain or have an illness or a problem
senses.distinguish: 後面接 from，指長期受到某種病痛或問題困擾。

example.en: Many office workers suffer from back pain after long hours.
example.zh: 許多上班族長時間工作後會背痛。

senses.en: to become worse because of a problem
senses.distinguish: 主詞是 quality、sales、health 等事物，表示它們變差。

example.en: Product quality may suffer if we shorten the testing period.
example.zh: 如果我們縮短測試期間，產品品質可能會變差。

extra_vocab.en: to bring goods to a place
extra_vocab.note: 在這句合約條款裡，delivers 是第三人稱單數，指供應商把貨物送到買方手上；「delivers goods after the deadline」就是超過期限才交貨，因此會被罰款。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: deliver 的主詞是送貨的一方；若要說貨「被送到」，用被動 be delivered（The goods were delivered）。

example.en: The goods were delivered to the wrong warehouse on Monday.
example.zh: 貨物在星期一被送到錯誤的倉庫。

example.en: Delivering orders on time is the key to customer satisfaction.
example.zh: 準時交貨是客戶滿意度的關鍵。

example.en: Trucks deliver goods to every branch in the region each week.
example.zh: 卡車每週把貨物送到區域內每一間分店。

example.en: The vendor promised to deliver on time during the holiday season.
example.zh: 廠商承諾在假期旺季也會準時交貨。

example.en: She will deliver a presentation on the new training platform.
example.zh: 她將發表關於新培訓平台的簡報。

example.en: The new manager worked hard to deliver on a promise to cut costs.
example.zh: 新經理努力兌現降低成本的承諾。

examples.en: The supplier usually delivers the goods within three working days.
examples.zh: 供應商通常會在三個工作天內交貨。

examples.en: Our team must deliver the final report to the client by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們團隊必須在星期五前把最終報告交給客戶。

examples.en: Our courier delivers to this address every weekday before noon.
examples.zh: 我們的快遞員每個平日中午前會送到這個地址。

similar.diff: ship 強調從公司把貨物寄出去；deliver 強調貨物送到目的地。

example.en: We ship all orders within two business days of payment.
example.zh: 我們在付款後兩個工作天內寄出所有訂單。

similar.diff: send 比較泛指「寄、送」，可用於信件、文件或物品；deliver 多指把東西送到指定地點或對象。

example.en: Please send the signed contract to our legal team by noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把簽好的合約寄給我們的法務團隊。

confusable.diff: discover 是「發現」，字尾 -ver 和重音位置都和 deliver 很像，但意思不同。

example.en: Inspectors often discover that the supplier delivers damaged parts.
example.zh: 檢驗人員常發現這家供應商送來的零件有損壞。

confusable.diff: deliberate 是形容詞「故意的」，開頭 deli- 和 deliver 很像，容易看錯或聽混。

example.en: The late delivery was not deliberate, so the buyer waived the fee.
example.zh: 延遲交貨不是故意的，所以買方免除了費用。

example.en: The vendor will supply all parts at a fixed price.
example.zh: 廠商將以固定價格供應所有零件。

example.en: We transport the goods by truck to the port every Friday.
example.zh: 我們每週五用卡車把貨物運到港口。

derived.link: deliver + -y，把動作變成名詞，像 discover → discovery、recover → recovery
deliver + -able，可以被交付的（東西），像 reliable、available

senses.en: to bring something to a person or a place

example.en: Please deliver the package to the front desk on the third floor.
example.zh: 請把包裹送到三樓的櫃檯。

senses.en: to do what you promised to do
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 results、promise、value 等抽象名詞時，指「做到、兌現」。

example.en: The software must deliver the results that we promised our clients.
example.zh: 這套軟體必須做到我們向客戶承諾的成果。

senses.en: to give a speech or a talk to a group
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 speech、presentation、talk 時，指「發表」。

example.en: The CEO will deliver the opening speech at the annual meeting.
example.zh: 執行長將在年會上發表開幕演說。
